evals.name: Roll a d20 explicitly requested
evals.expected_output: The response creates tasks for the dice roll, executes a bash command to generate a random number between 1 and 20, and describes generating a d20 image with the result.

assertions.text: The response includes a bash command using RANDOM % 20 or equivalent to generate a number between 1 and 20
The response explicitly mentions d20 or 20-sided die
The response mentions generating or creating an image of the dice result
The response references tasks or steps that will be executed (e.g., confirming sides, executing roll, generating visualization)

evals.name: Roll a d6 standard die
evals.expected_output: The response creates tasks, runs a bash command for a 1-6 random number, and describes a d6 image visualization.

assertions.text: The response includes a bash command using RANDOM % 6 or Get-Random with Maximum 7 to generate a number from 1 to 6
The response mentions d6 or 6-sided die or 6 caras
The response describes or implies the result will be a number between 1 and 6 inclusive
The response mentions creating or displaying a visual representation of the die and its result

evals.name: Roll dice without specifying number of sides
evals.expected_output: The response asks the user to choose the number of sides before rolling, offering options like d6, d20, d10 via structured question or enumerated options.

assertions.text: The response asks the user to specify the number of sides or type of die before rolling
The response offers at least two distinct die options (e.g., d6, d20, d10) for the user to choose from
The response does NOT include a bash command executing a dice roll before the number of sides is confirmed
